workflow.name: Smart Inventory Replenishment & Auto-Purchase Orders
workflow.description: Scheduled workflow that checks warehouse stock every 6 hours, fetches sales velocity, merges data, uses GPT AI to forecast demand, filters products needing reorder, creates purchase orders, sends them to suppliers, logs to ERP, saves to database, and sends email notifications.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key for demand forecasting

workflow_steps.name: Schedule Trigger
workflow_steps.description: Fires every 6 hours to kick off the inventory check cycle

workflow_steps.name: Fetch Current Inventory
workflow_steps.description: Retrieve current stock levels from warehouse system

workflow_steps.name: Merge Inventory & Sales Data
workflow_steps.description: Join inventory and sales records by product_id

workflow_steps.name: AI Demand Forecasting
workflow_steps.description: GPT-5.1 analyzes each product and forecasts whether reorder is needed

workflow_steps.name: Save to Database
workflow_steps.description: Insert PO record into SQLite database

workflow_steps.name: Send Notification Email
workflow_steps.description: Email the procurement team about the new purchase order
